title: AI grounding
rule: Answer from approved, current, role-authorized sources. Cite source IDs. If evidence is missing or conflicting, say it cannot be verified and offer human help.

title: Ticket confirmation
rule: AI may draft a ticket but must show category, department, priority and description and ask for confirmation before submission.

title: Routing
rule: Use deterministic category-to-department rules. Model predictions are suggestions only. Low-confidence or sensitive cases require human review.

title: Authorization
rule: Backend validates identity, current role, account status, ownership and department authorization. AI predictions never grant permissions.

title: Audit
rule: Record actor, action, entity, timestamp, correlation ID and minimal metadata for privileged changes. Never log passwords, tokens or OTPs.

title: Privacy
rule: Internal notes are never returned to students. Confidential grievances are restricted to authorized reviewers.

title: SLA
rule: Demo targets are calendar-hour examples only. Production must define working hours, holidays, pause rules and escalation owners.

title: Official records
rule: AI must not modify attendance, fee status, marks, eligibility or close tickets outside the approved backend workflow.

title: Files
rule: Use private storage, validate file type/signature, enforce size/count limits and authorize every download.

title: Reopening
rule: Demo rule: student may request reopening once within seven calendar days after RESOLVED; backend validates and logs request.
